info.title: Modular MCP Release and Operations API

post.description: Creates or starts a deployment for an approved candidate. This operation does not open the MCP endpoint or grant published access; publishDeployment is the only release operation that opens published MCP access.

body.reason: Publish approved candidate version 1.0.0 to production.
body.impact: Opens the MCP endpoint to authorized clients for service version 1.0.0.
body.recoveryPlan: Pause service calls or roll traffic back if post-publish verification fails.

post.description: Publishes a healthy deployment and opens published MCP endpoint access for clients with valid credentials and policy authorization.

body.impact: New requests using this credential are rejected immediately.
body.recoveryPlan: Create a replacement credential if access is still needed.

body.impact: New MCP calls are rejected while existing credentials remain configured.
body.recoveryPlan: Resume calls after deployment health is confirmed.

body.impact: MCP calls may be accepted again for authorized clients.
body.recoveryPlan: Pause calls again if health checks degrade.

body.impact: Existing access remains governed; new credentials are blocked.
New credentials and authorizations may be issued again; existing clients continue under policy.
body.recoveryPlan: Stop issuing new access again if policy verification fails.

body.impact: Clients pinned to this version must migrate before retirement completes.
body.recoveryPlan: Rollback traffic if migration verification fails.

CreateCredential.description: Credential creation response with one-time Secret

NotFoundOrDeniedError.description: Resource not found or caller is not authorized; response does not distinguish existence.

ConflictError.description: State, digest, review, deployment, or idempotency conflict

error.nextAction: Check your access or choose another resource.

error.message: The approved definition digest does not match the runtime artifact.
error.nextAction: Rebuild from the approved definition and investigate the mismatch.

PublishDeploymentRequest.description: High-impact request that publishes a deployment. Publishing opens the MCP endpoint; deployCandidate only starts deployment preparation.

oneTimeSecret.description: Displayed exactly once at creation or rotation time. Never returned from ordinary reads.

serviceVersionStatus.description: Lifecycle state of the published service version.

deploymentStatus.description: Lifecycle and health state of the current environment deployment.
